about: The nightly integrity watch on a database the clean start has just reset (design final.first_night_integrity): the statuses each check may have on the reset day (night1, right after COMMIT) and on the next Oman morning (night2, 02:30 UTC). A check missing here, or a status not listed, is a mismatch. rehearse-watch.ts asserts it; tests/integration/clean-start.test.ts runs it.

withForeignSeals.about: When PLAN found objects under seals/ that are not production's chain (another environment's chain folder, a non-seal object), the first run reports each once, as new and critical, and the next as information. Accepted ONLY when every open finding is one of those pre-listed keys.

night2NotAssertedBeforeUtcHour.about: Night 2 is simulated at 02:30 UTC of the next Oman day, but the windowed jobs (03:00-15:00 UTC) of the reset day have not all run yet when the rehearsal starts before 15:00 UTC: their gaps would be real absences in the copy, not on production. The check is then reported, not asserted.
